data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek 'Nikos' meaning victory, and 'Laos' meaning people. The name Nikola symbolizes the triumph of the common man. The name Nikola carries the meaning “Victory of the people” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Nikola usually hope their child will grow to embody victory of the people and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_hebrew.name: ניקולה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם ניקולה מקורו ביוונית ומשמעותו נצחון העם. הוא מורכב משתי מילים: ניקוס (נצחון) ואוס (עם). השם ניקולה היה שמו של קדוש נוצרי חשוב, הקדוש ניקולאי, שהיה בישוף במאה ה-4 לספירה.

in_greek.name: Νικόλαος
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Νικόλαος προέρχεται από τις ελληνικές λέξεις νίκη (νικος) και λαός (λαοσ) και σημαίνει νίκη του λαού. Ο Άγιος Νικόλαος ήταν εξέχων χριστιανός άγιος και επίσκοπος της Μύρας στη Μικρά Ασία κατά τον 4ο αιώνα μ.Χ.

in_latin.name: Nikola
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Nikola derivatur ex vocabulis Graecis nikē (victoria) et laos (populus), significans victoriam populi. Sanctus Nicolaus, episcopus Myrensis in Asia Minore, fuit importantissimus Christianorum sanctus in 4to secundo post Christum natum.

in_english.name: Nikola
in_english.long_meaning: The name Nikola originates from Greek roots, meaning 'victory of the people'. Derived from nikē (victory) and laos (people), Nikola has significant historical and spiritual connotations. Saint Nicholas, a 4th-century bishop of Myra, was a prominent Christian saint, known for his generosity and kindness. The name Nikola symbolizes triumph and communal success, reflecting values of leadership and benevolence.

data.cultural_impact: The name Nikola has been popular in various cultures throughout history, including in Eastern Europe and the Greek Orthodox Church. In Bulgaria, Saint Nikola is a revered figure known as the protector of sailors and merchants. In Russia, Nikola Tesla, an inventor, engineer, and futurist, bore this name and made significant contributions to the development of modern electricity. Nicknames associated with this name include Nik, Nico, and Kolja.
data.spiritual_significance: According to Christian belief, Saint Nikola was a bishop from Myra in the province of Lycia, in present-day southern Turkey. He was known for his generosity and kindness, providing secret gifts to the needy, even going so far as to leave gold in the shoes of three sisters who could not afford a dowry. This act represents Nikola's compassion, strength, and dedication to uplifting the less fortunate. The name Nikola highlights the spiritual qualities of love, kindness, and self-sacrifice to improve lives.
data.spiritual_symbolism: As a name associated with Saint Saint Nicholas, it represents holiness, devotion, and Christian virtue.
